# Base64 presence and reflection placement controls

These controls distinguish Base64 decoding, encoded function-name presence,
and reflective method selection. Positive PHP requires the indexed decoder,
encoded file-write name, and array callback dispatch. Negative PHP contains
only the unencoded name. Positive PowerShell selects FromBase64 methods;
negative PowerShell selects ToBase64 methods.

The function-name literal moves from decode/base64 to encoding/base64.
The callback co-occurrence profile and GetMethods selector move to
metaprogramming/reflection. Matchers and scopes are retained; the literal
matcher spelling is normalized from string_literal to literal.

The encoded `file_put_contents` name now has one canonical atom at
`micro-behaviors/fs/write/file/full::php-base64-file-write-function-name`.
Its specific file-write capability owns the observation; Base64 is the
representation. The duplicate in encoding/base64 is removed, and has-encoding
references the canonical atom. The exact literal, PHP scope, criticality and
callback profile requirements are unchanged.

Exact webshell and PowerShell consumers follow the moves. The has-encoding
selector retains the moved name and method filter explicitly. Other audited
base64 directory consumers require decoding: encoded-C2 configuration,
public-service decoded body, PNG LSB loader, and described stego extraction.
They should not treat an encoded function name or reflective method lookup
alone as proof of decoding. The PHP profile still requires the indexed decoder,
so those directory selectors retain its underlying decoding observation.

The original leaf held 103 rules. These three corrections leave 100 without
creating a new taxonomy partition or dropping the underlying observations.

Additional controls reject billing credits as upstream attribution and keep a
SKILL.json path independent of product identity. Riffkit name declarations,
URL references and credential-handling prose now have neutral homes. The
Riffkit-name exception is removed: declarations cannot establish benignness.
The curl download controls require SKILL.md as the output basename; fetching
that URL, saving another name, or saving NOTSKILL.md is insufficient.

Reference Markdown path atoms were consolidated in documentation/source;
policy guidance moved to documentation/agent-safety. Python inline invocation
moved to process/create/eval. Heading counts and generic assistant-reference
counts now describe their literal observations rather than a guide genre or
multiple product identities. Existing exact consumers follow each move.

Named Riffkit HTTPS URLs use the provider-specific HTTP services home.
The login-credential phrase is a documentation declaration under claims;
it asserts no protective behavior on its own. The output path matcher uses
a bounded token and exact SKILL.md basename.
